title: Duration of Skin Numbing Effect Created by the S-Caine™ Peel
brief_summary: S-Caine™ Peel (lidocaine 7% and tetracaine 7% cream) is a new skin numbing cream made of lidocaine and tetracaine. The purpose of this study is to evaluate and measure the length of time the S-Caine Peel numbs the skin, when applied for 30 and 60 minutes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject is 18 years of age or older.
* Meet pinprick test requirements.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject is pregnant or breastfeeding.
* Subject has participated in a clinical trial of an unapproved drug within the previous 30 days.
